title: LC Highpass Pi
text: Model LC highpass pi network, {Plot type} sets Type of data plot X-Y; {Inductance (H)} sets the inductance of the LC Highpass Pi, {Capacitance (F)} sets the capacitance of the LC Highpass Pi, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Inductance (H)
params.values: Inductance of the LC Highpass Pi [1.1881e-6 1.1881e-6] (default) | vector
